leadText:
A Reporter (Japanese: レポーター Reporter) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that first debuted in the Generation IV games. They are young women working as television reporters.

In Generations IV and VIII, they specialize in - and Pokémon. 

Reporters are the female counterparts of . When paired with Cameramen in Double Battles, they are called . In Pokémon Sword and Shield, they appear exclusively as a part of this Trainer class, except in the .
